repair.problem: The CPU interpreter evaluated both boolean operands in every active lane. Everglade cut==0 shadow geometry could therefore sample an unused texture layer, producing an artificial resource refusal.
repair.change: Evaluate the logical RHS only for active true lanes of AND or active false lanes of OR; preserve termination and first-error ordering. Reject a numeric logical LHS before reading its RHS.
repair.test_first: Independent hand-assembled typed expressions failed before the repair. Their untaken lanes divide by zero; all512 active-mask/boolean-pattern/operator combinations and2 numeric-left refusal cases are checked.
repair.initial_mutation: 2421 mutants,2420 killed,1 survivor. Refactored the redundant combined type/operator predicate into an observable first-error type admission and added its refused-case check. The failed run remains retained; no equivalent-mutant waiver was used.
repair.independent_review: Agent1 reviewed lane masks, termination, first-error preservation, test coverage and bounded arithmetic; no defect found.
repair.separate_select_protocol: An initial experiment also masked the arms of checked-tree select. The existing shader-lowering/derivative fixture rejected that change. It was withdrawn; op24 retains its original eager protocol semantics. Both the failed check and its proposed fixture are retained.
